categories.main_business_segments: Zhongjin Gold Corporation primarily operates in gold and non-ferrous metal mining, beneficiation, and smelting. The company’s core products include gold concentrate, mixed gold, standard gold, copper, silver, and sulfuric acid. It also engages in the production, processing, wholesale of high-purity gold products, and related import-export and commodity exhibition businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced mining and smelting technologies, including proprietary pyrometallurgical arsenic removal techniques and digital mine construction. It emphasizes full-process cost control, energy-saving measures, and technological innovation to optimize production efficiency and product quality. The company also holds LBMA certification for its gold products and invests heavily in R&D with a focus on mining and smelting technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhongjin Gold serves primarily industrial customers in the precious metals and non-ferrous metals sectors, including gold and copper product buyers. A significant portion of its sales is conducted through the Shanghai Gold Exchange online platform, targeting domestic and international markets. The company also sells to affiliated parties within the China National Gold Group system, which accounts for a large share of its revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with mining and smelting facilities distributed across key mineral-rich regions including Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, Henan, Liaoning, Heilongjiang, Gansu, and Shandong provinces. It also has investments and operations in other provinces such as Hubei and Jiangxi. The company’s registered office is in Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhongjin Gold operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the gold and copper supply chain, including exploration, mining, beneficiation, and smelting. It also engages in downstream activities such as high-purity gold product processing and wholesale. The company controls significant mineral resources and integrates resource acquisition, production, and sales within its operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-quality development, resource acquisition, and technological innovation. It prioritizes increasing resource reserves through exploration and acquisitions, advancing digital mining, and enhancing cost control and environmental sustainability. R&D efforts focus on mining and smelting technologies, with substantial investment in patent development and high-tech enterprise certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of gold and copper products, including gold concentrate, mixed gold, standard gold, and cathode copper. Sales are conducted via centralized sales channels, including the Shanghai Gold Exchange platform and spot market transactions. The company also earns income from by-products and related services, with a significant portion of sales to affiliated entities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhongjin Gold is positioned as a leading gold mining and smelting enterprise in China, with strong backing from its controlling shareholder, China National Gold Group. It competes with other major domestic gold producers and benefits from integrated resource control and technological advantages. The company emphasizes its resource base, technological capabilities, and market reputation to maintain competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Zhongjin Gold reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 65.56 billion, a 7.01% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.39 billion, up 13.71%. Total assets reached RMB 556.39 billion, with net assets of RMB 273.93 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth in revenue, profitability, and asset quality, supported by increased R&D investment and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company’s value proposition centers on its extensive resource base, advanced technological capabilities, and integrated mining-to-smelting operations. It offers high-purity gold products certified by LBMA and leverages proprietary technologies to improve product quality and environmental performance. Zhongjin Gold emphasizes cost control, sustainable development, and strong governance to deliver value to shareholders and customers.
